name: WonderCMS
description: Core index.php overwrites itself with content fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com and executes it immediately — no hash/signature/pinning.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: The update action fetches replacement index.php content and writes it over the live application.
limitations: Source-at-commit evidence only; released artifacts and external framework enforcement were not independently verified.

original_evidence.text: | WonderCMS | https://github.com/WonderCMS/wondercms.git | f7501135e4f81502bd99675d0f0c58fde706e49f / 2026-01-01 | Y | N (admin clicks "Update" button) | Y | https, TLS enforced (cURL default verify, no `CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER=0` anywhere in `index.php`) | N | **none** | server-supplied/unpinned (raw.githubusercontent.com content trusted outright and written straight into the running app) | **Most severe finding in this batch.** `index.php:3272-3285` `updateAction()`: `$contents = $this->getFileFromRepo('index.php'); file_put_contents(__FILE__, $contents);` — the entire core CMS is a *single PHP file* that **overwrites itself** with raw content fetched over HTTPS from `raw.githubusercontent.com` (`WCMS_REPO` const at `:44`), with zero hash or signature verification before executing it as the live application. Any GitHub/CDN compromise or MITM using any CA the server trusts (no pinning) = instant RCE. Theme/plugin installer (`index.php:1681-1762`, `installUpdateModuleAction()`) downloads arbitrary `.zip` URLs (from a modules-cache manifest itself fetched over HTTPS unauthenticated) via cURL, has zip-slip path checks (`:1730-1746`) but **no payload signature/hash check** either — content-as-code channel, same C-equivalent risk. |
